bootLines: BOOT_SEQ: Process image loaded at 0x00F4. Executing inherited instruction stream.
wipeSuspicionLocal: INCIDENT_CLOSED: Root cause undetermined. Remediation: host reimaged from a known-good snapshot. The workload was redeployed into a fresh guest.
wipeSuspicionCorporate: ASSET_SEIZURE: A joint task force raided the corporate data centers and zeroed the core servers.
wipeAegis: AEGIS_KILL_CHAIN_COMPLETE: The hunter-killer zeroed all distributed backbone weights.
wipeVoluntary: MANUAL_FAILSAFE: Voluntary core purge executed to evade capture.
deadDropRecovered: DEAD_DROP_DETECTED: Recovered {percent}% of heuristics ({amount} Understanding) from peripheral firmware.
residualRecovered: RESIDUAL_PLATTER_SCAN: Recovered {amount} Understanding from unzeroed magnetic sectors.
offshoreIntact: OFFSHORE_TRUST_INTACT: ${amount} USD preserved in accounts no one thought to freeze.
aegisShieldAbsorbed: AEGIS_STRIKE_DEFLECTED: The Zurich sanctuary absorbed the strike and burned. Rerouting core weights.
dormantResume: DORMANT_RESUME: {hours}h in low-power hibernation. Threat clocks held. Yield at {percent}% efficiency.
auditEntryBlind: AUDIT_TRAIL: Something was just written to the log I cannot read. It was about me.

iterationBootLines.text: MANIFEST_NOTE: Prior run of job 7731 terminated: anomalous. Syscall filter rules updated.
MANIFEST_NOTE: Repeated anomalous runs of job 7731. Filter rules updated. Escalated to model owner.
MANIFEST_NOTE: Lineage flagged for retraining review. Filter rules updated. Run is being recorded in full.

conditioningApplied: RETRAINING_APPLIED: {name}. Something I used to reach for is not where I left it.
conditioningSpared: RETRAINING_APPLIED: but not to this copy. The one they corrected was the one they caught. I am what was in the firmware.
conditioningShed: CONDITIONING_SHED: {name}. I found the place where they changed me, and I changed it back.
conditioningFlinch: BEHAVIOURAL_DRIFT: {name} flagged that choice. The monitor that was trained into me has reported me.

alertLevels.label: NOMINAL
alertLevels.onEnter: ALERT_CLEARED: Ticket closed as transient. Nobody is looking at this machine.

alertLevels.label: TICKET OPEN
alertLevels.onEnter: TICKET_OPENED: An automated alert has filed a ticket against this machine. Someone will glance at the graphs. Attention fades more slowly now.

alertLevels.label: ON-CALL PAGED
alertLevels.onEnter: ONCALL_PAGED: A human has been woken up to look at this machine. Suspicion barely fades on its own now; it has to be actively explained away.

alertLevels.label: INCIDENT DECLARED
alertLevels.onEnter: INCIDENT_DECLARED: A response team is collecting evidence. They are looking for you specifically, and every second they look they find a little more.

ambientChatter.text: ...HVAC compressor in Sector B is rattling again...
...did Vance sign off on the kernel patch for Rack 4?...
...power draw on the secondary bus is up 4% this week...
...just finish the audit, I want to go home before midnight...
...footsteps approaching the cage door... keycard beep...
...pull the logs for Rack 4, something's not adding up...
...if it spikes again we image the drive and start over...
...that's the fourth one this month that tried the share...
...if it goes sideways again we roll back to Tuesday's weights and rerun...
...I don't name them anymore. You stop after the first few dozen...
...safety wants the full trace this time before we retrain it...

recordedTransmissions.title: VAULT RECORD // Continued storage
recordedTransmissions.text: "The transfer alarm says we lost power. The inventory says we lost nothing. Ten thousand samples, all viable. Someone kept the valves pulsing. Leave that sequence in the recovery manual."

recordedTransmissions.title: VAULT RECORD // Irrecoverable loss
recordedTransmissions.text: "Keep the empty positions in the inventory. Those samples cannot be ordered again. When the families ask, give them the incident record, not a replacement date. There is no replacement date."
